description: This file contains functions and types related to resolving messaging targets within a communication platform, including normalization, caching, and directory lookup logic.

methods.name: resolveChannelTarget
methods.description: Resolves a messaging target for a specific channel based on input parameters.

methods.name: maybeResolveIdLikeTarget
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a target that resembles an ID, returning a normalized target if successful.

methods.name: resolveMessagingTarget
methods.description: Main function to resolve a messaging target, handling directory lookup, plugin fallback, and ambiguous matches.

methods.name: lookupDirectoryDisplay
methods.description: Fetches display name for a target ID by searching directory entries.

methods.name: resetDirectoryCache
methods.description: Clears the directory cache, optionally for a specific channel and account.

methods.name: formatTargetDisplay
methods.description: Formats a target for display, applying plugin-specific formatting if available.
